name: Molecolab Supplier Catalogue Sync
author: molecolab

sections.description:
Molecolab Supplier Catalogue Sync imports supplier prices, availability and product data from a file or remote URL. It includes assisted field mapping, price rules, dry-run previews, scheduled and resumable synchronization, missing-product safety rules, diagnostics, audit logs and rollback.

After source analysis, detected fields become guided choices in every mapping control. Choices remain editable for nested JSON/XML paths, are isolated to the current user and source, and expire after 30 minutes.

The System health section can download a support bundle containing version, scheduler, queue and aggregate run information. Persistent local administrator notices flag failed or safety-stopped work without including catalogue or product data; email notifications remain a Pro capability. The bundle deliberately excludes catalogue URLs, product identifiers, feed contents, rollback snapshots and raw errors.

Supplier Catalogue Sync does not send telemetry to Molecolab. Catalogue sources are processed on your WordPress site. Temporary source files are removed after staging. Detailed jobs and rollback snapshots are retained for 30 days; summary logs are retained for 90 days.

Supported catalogue data

The Free edition supports CSV, JSON and XML catalogues. Products are matched by SKU. You can map name, supplier price, selling-price source, stock, description, ordered image URLs, categories, GTIN and simple-product attributes. Images and categories accept JSON arrays or pipe-separated values; the first image becomes featured and the remainder form the gallery. Attributes accept a JSON object or Name=Value|Name=Value syntax. Simple WooCommerce products are created or updated; variations and authenticated connectors are outside the Free 1.0 scope.

Safety and recovery

Every manual synchronization requires a fresh preview and confirmation bound to the administrator, configuration, connector and feed contents. Approval expires after 30 minutes and is consumed once. An approved manual run establishes the automation baseline; source, mapping or product-rule changes block scheduled writes until another approved run. Scheduler frequency and batch size do not change that baseline. Supplier Catalogue Sync validates feeds, resumes interrupted jobs, limits retries, skips unchanged products and records reversible snapshots. Cancellation can release a queued or staging job only before product application. A job without a heartbeat for ten minutes can be resumed explicitly through the same fenced worker path. A safety stop blocks missing-product actions when a feed is invalid or unexpectedly smaller than the previous successful feed.

External services

Supplier Catalogue Sync makes no requests to Molecolab and sends no telemetry. It contacts only catalogue URLs and product-image URLs explicitly configured by a store administrator. These requests are necessary to download the configured supplier data or images; the remote provider receives the store server’s IP address and standard HTTP request metadata. The terms and privacy policy of that provider apply. Removing the configured URL or disabling automatic synchronization stops scheduled catalogue requests.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate Molecolab Supplier Catalogue Sync.
  2. Install and activate WooCommerce if WordPress has not already done so as a declared dependency.
  3. Open WooCommerce > Supplier Catalogue Sync and complete the setup wizard.
  4. Configure a source and review the suggested field mapping.
  5. Run a simulation before the first live synchronization.
sections.faq:
Does Supplier Catalogue Sync send store or catalogue data to Molecolab?

No. Supplier Catalogue Sync includes no Molecolab telemetry. Your site contacts only remote catalogue and image URLs that you configure.

What data is retained?

Temporary source files are deleted after staging. Synchronization history and rollback snapshots are retained for 30 days. Removing the plugin through WordPress deletes its settings, logs, job tables, managed-product markers, and temporary files.

Which external services does Supplier Catalogue Sync contact?

Supplier Catalogue Sync makes no requests to Molecolab. It contacts only catalogue URLs and product-image URLs explicitly configured by a store administrator. These requests are necessary to download the configured supplier data or image; the remote provider receives the store server’s IP address and standard HTTP request metadata. The terms and privacy policy of that provider apply. Removing the configured URL or disabling automatic synchronization stops scheduled catalogue requests.

Does it support variable products or authenticated APIs?

Not in the Free 1.0 release. It manages simple products and public HTTP(S), upload, CSV, JSON and XML sources. Variations, XLSX, SFTP and authenticated API connectors are planned as separate Pro/Cloud capabilities.

Where can I get support?

Use the WordPress.org support forum for the Free edition. Include the System health results and relevant run summary, but never post catalogue contents, credentials or private supplier URLs.
